description: recipe-water: KL408 on a recipe input naming the game's old Water canteen item (a definition and a rule), on water at a factory station without a tank (by its id, by a base recipe's workshop, a rule on a game recipe), and above a tank; none at a tank station within its tank, by hand, or for water 0. A negative water is the schema's.

diagnostics.message: recipe "Fx_Smelter_Water" needs 2 water a craft at the Smelter, which has no water tank: the station never starts it (it takes a recipe's water from its own tank only). Stations with a tank: Seedbed, Oven, Cooking Station, Laboratory, Coffee Brewer, Beehive; or leave the water out
recipe "Fx_Beehive_Flood" needs 60 water a craft, more than the Beehive's tank holds (50): the station never starts it

recipe "Fx_Canteen" takes "Food_T1_raw_hydration_Water_Pouch_Filled_DEPRECATED", the game's old Water canteen item, as an ingredient: a craft takes 2 of that item, never water from the station's tank. For the station's tank water, remove this input and give the recipe "water": 2 (water charges a craft)

recipe "Fx_Based_On_Smelter" needs 1 water a craft at the Smelter, which has no water tank: the station never starts it (it takes a recipe's water from its own tank only). Stations with a tank: Seedbed, Oven, Cooking Station, Laboratory, Coffee Brewer, Beehive; or leave the water out

recipe "Recipe_Fixture_Smelter_Bar" needs 4 water a craft at the Smelter, which has no water tank: the station never starts it (it takes a recipe's water from its own tank only). Stations with a tank: Seedbed, Oven, Cooking Station, Laboratory, Coffee Brewer, Beehive; or leave the water out

recipe "Recipe_Fixture_Oven_Bread" takes "Food_T1_raw_hydration_Water_Pouch_Filled_DEPRECATED", the game's old Water canteen item, as an ingredient: a craft takes 1 of that item, never water from the station's tank. For the station's tank water, remove this input and give the recipe "waterCharges": 1 (water charges a craft)
